task_completion.description: Open the baseline .ork file in OpenRocket and run the initial simulation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing OpenRocket open with 'transonic_rocket.ork' loaded and the simulation results table showing baseline Max Velocity and Max Altitude.

task_completion.description: Change the cross-section of all fin sets (booster and sustainer) to 'Airfoil'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The component configuration dialog for each fin set showing the 'Cross section' dropdown set to 'Airfoil'.

task_completion.description: Change the Surface Finish of all external components (Nose Cone, Body Tubes, Transitions, Fin Sets) to 'Polished'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Appearance' or 'General' tab in the configuration dialogs for these components showing 'Surface finish' set to 'Polished'.

task_completion.description: Re-run the simulation to calculate the new performance metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The simulation list in OpenRocket showing a fresh run with updated (higher) Max Velocity and Max Altitude values.
The 'Save As' dialog or the window title bar showing the file path /home/ga/Documents/rockets/transonic_rocket_optimized.ork.

task_completion.description: Create a text report comparing the before and after simulation results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing /home/ga/Documents/exports/aerodynamic_report.txt containing both baseline and optimized velocity/altitude data.

integrity.description: The agent must use the OpenRocket GUI to change component properties, not just edit the XML file directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with OpenRocket dialog boxes and dropdown menus.

integrity.description: The report must contain values derived from the actual simulation run, not placeholder or hallucinated numbers.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numbers in the final .txt report must match the numbers visible in the OpenRocket simulation results table in previous screenshots.

integrity.description: The agent must save files to the specific paths requested in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file manager or save dialogs showing the exact paths: /home/ga/Documents/rockets/ and /home/ga/Documents/exports/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The baseline rocket has 'Rough' finish and 'Square' fins. Changing to 'Polished' and 'Airfoil' significantly reduces the drag coefficient (Cd), resulting in a higher Max Velocity and Max Altitude. The VLM should verify that the 'Airfoil' setting is applied to BOTH the sustainer fin set and the booster fin set.
